brief: How we cut our AWS bill by 70% without losing performance — before and after the migration.

slots.title: Stop burning cash
slots.description: We cut our cloud bill by 70% without dropping a single request. Here is the exact before-and-after playbook.

slots.title: Find the waste
slots.description: We mapped every instance and found 80% of our fleet was sleeping on the job. Visibility is the prerequisite to savings.
slots.badText: We guessed instance sizes and left everything running around the clock.
slots.goodText: Rightsizing with auto-scaling cut idle compute by 60% instantly.

slots.title: Fix storage bloat
slots.description: Old snapshots and unattached volumes were silently eating 30% of the budget. A lifecycle policy fixed it overnight.
slots.badText: Hundreds of orphaned EBS volumes and endless S3 buckets with no rules.
slots.goodText: Automated tiering and volume cleanup dropped storage spend by 80%.

slots.title: Commit to save
slots.description: On-demand pricing punished our predictable workloads. Switching to Savings Plans locked in a 40% compute discount immediately.
slots.badText: We paid on-demand rates for steady 24/7 production workloads.
slots.goodText: A one-year Savings Plan cut compute costs with zero engineering work.

slots.title: Embrace spot fleets
slots.description: Stateless workloads tolerated interruptions. We moved them to Spot and slashed that slice of the bill by another 60%.
slots.badText: Every job ran on expensive on-demand instances with no interruption handling.
slots.goodText: Spot fleets with fallback saved thousands and never dropped a task.

slots.title: Stop data leaks
slots.description: Cross-AZ traffic and unoptimized CloudFront configs were hiding a $2K monthly surprise. We fixed routing and caching headers.
slots.badText: We ignored data-transfer lines on the bill until they ballooned.
slots.goodText: Single-AZ placement and compression cut egress by 75% this quarter.

slots.title: Lock in gains
slots.description: Tagging policies and budget alerts now stop waste before it starts. Cost awareness became part of our engineering culture.
slots.badText: No tags, no owners, and surprise bills every month end.
slots.goodText: Real-time dashboards and automated shutdowns keep spend flat and visible.

slots.body: Replicate our migration playbook and stop paying for idle compute, storage, and data transfer you do not need.
